applyDialog.title: Apply new template
applyDialog.description:
You are about to apply a new template. This action will permanently delete your current innovation flow. However, the existing Posts linked to different phases will remain and be grouped under the first phase of the new setup.

Please choose one of the following options:
applyDialog.sidebarNote: The subspace sidebar will be replaced by the template's.

option1.label: Replace with new flow
option1.description: This will delete your current innovation flow with all existing Posts and replace it with the new flow including the template Posts.

option2.label: Replace and add template Posts to existing ones
option2.description: This will include the new Posts from the template in addition to your existing ones.

option3.label: Replace flow without adding template Posts
option3.description: Only replace innovation flow without adding template Posts.

confirmDelete.title: Confirm Deletion
confirmDelete.description: This action will permanently delete all existing Posts and replace them with Posts from the template. This cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to proceed?
